args.sql:
WITH mce_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        maintregistry,
        (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw AS mce
    FROM maintenance m
    JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
),
avg_mce AS (
    SELECT AVG(mce) AS average_mce FROM mce_cte
)
SELECT maintregistry
FROM mce_cte, avg_mce
WHERE mce_cte.mce < average_mce.average_mce;

WITH mce_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        maintregistry,
        (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw AS mce
    FROM maintenance m
    JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
),
avg_mce AS (
    SELECT AVG(mce) AS average_mce 
    FROM mce_cte
)
SELECT m.maintregistry
FROM mce_cte
JOIN avg_mce
ON 1=1 
WHERE mce_cte.mce > avg_mce.average_mce;
